answer: One walker covers two crossings in three hours. Each epoch, thirty ferrous tags open for one tundra crossing. A tag locks 60 POA, +30 per extra tag from one root, so ten linked fakes lock 1,950 POA. Each crossing needs four checkpoint stamps from strangers who stamp at most two crossings each. Ten fakes need five walkers, ten crossings, forty stamps inside one three-hour window. A crossing with no fable — the stamped log of its walk — burns 25 POA; a fable filed twice burns both bonds. Stamp times are matched to funding roots: ten crossings walked by one walker collapse into a single claim.
